## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintenance change.

## Checks

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests first and observed the expected failure.
- [ ] Ran relevant tests and the full solution test suite.
- [ ] Ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] Updated English and Russian documentation/localization where applicable.
- [ ] Did not add signing material, release outputs, package-store mutations, or hardware writes to CI.

## Risk and rollback

Describe Windows/Dynamic Lighting, settings migration, package-registration, or hardware-safety impact. State how the change can be safely reverted.
